findings.description: Front track 1520 mm, rear track 1509 mm and ground clearance 200 mm imported for five exact source-linked Eco-G 120 configurations (15 historical observations).
Overall length 4102 mm, wheelbase 2604 mm, front overhang 833 mm and rear overhang 665 mm are already present for all five configurations from exact 2026-06-26 configuration PDFs.

Roof height with rails 1586 mm and body height without rails 1535 mm are already present for all five configurations from exact saved configuration PDFs dated 2026-08-09. Overall width with mirrors 2012 mm is already present for all five configurations from 2026-06-26 PDFs.

The 1853 mm width label is not imported. Existing configuration PDFs record overall_width 1784 mm, while another source expresses 1853/2012 mm as folded/unfolded exterior-mirror width. Exact mirror-state semantics require visual reconciliation.
Interior top-view values 1408, 1406 and 1026 mm and seatback angles 14° remain excluded; no dedicated semantic mapping is established.

boundaries: Only exact source-linked Eco-G 120 configurations are covered; no TCe 110 or Hybrid 155 inference.
Existing source-specific observations were reused and not duplicated.
The 1853 mm overall-width semantic conflict remains deferred.
Interior measurements and seatback angles are excluded.

report_metadata.scope: Page-20 exterior-dimension crosswalk and append-only import of three verified missing attributes for five exact source-related Eco-G 120 configurations.
